scope: Real-time desert-locust breeding-risk screen using real SMAP soil-moisture-anomaly and real Sentinel-2 NDVI green-up signal, standard FAO DLIS-style logic. Thresholds (SM anomaly >= 0.02 m3/m3, NDVI delta >= 0.03) are standard qualitative bands, NOT locally fitted/validated against any real locust survey ground truth this week -- treat as a screening signal, not a validated forecast. Cholistan has no official boundary anywhere (see per-region boundary_note) -- proxy geometry substantially overstates true desert extent.

regions.boundary_note: real district polygon(s) from geoBoundaries ADM2
regions.source: NASA SMAP L4 SPL4SMGP v008 (real, ~11km, own built-in anomaly) + Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized NDVI (real, cloud-masked, 100m reduce scale)

regions.boundary_note: NO official Cholistan boundary exists anywhere accessible (checked OSM, zero results) -- this is the real-geometry union of the 3 Punjab districts (Bahawalpur, Bahawalnagar, Rahim Yar Khan) reported to contain the Cholistan Desert, NOT a Cholistan-specific boundary. Substantially overstates true desert extent.
